subject: Case study rewards coordination — credits, swag, and donation receipt
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah@brightlinehealth.com>, donations@brightline.org
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: Case study rewards coordination — credits, swag, and donation receipt

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for agreeing to take part in our Redwood Inference case study. We really appreciate the time your team spent during the interview and the detailed feedback. To show our thanks, we can offer one of two options (or both, if you prefer):

- A $2,000 Redwood platform credit applied to your account (can be split across teams).
- A curated swag pack (approx. $150 retail value) shipped to a contact of your choice.
- Alternatively, we can match the swag value with a charitable donation to Brightline’s foundation and provide a donation receipt for your records.

Could you confirm: 1) Which option you prefer, 2) Shipping address for the swag if you pick that, and 3) Billing/procurement contact to route the credit/invoice to (PO or invoice required?). If you elect the donation route, please share the exact name and EIN to appear on the receipt.

We’ll coordinate shipping and attach a provisional credit note and draft donation receipt for your review once you confirm.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Program Manager, Customer Advocacy
Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0189

Mina — quick internal note on process and approvals:

1) Credit: We can issue a non-expiring account credit tied to deal DL-78902. Finance will need a short memo and the billing contact to apply the credit (typically done within 3–5 business days after approval).

2) Swag: If we were shipping, ops would use 3PL partner ParcelFlow. For donation-match, we need to confirm whether Redwood should push the donation directly to Brightline Foundation (via ACH) or whether Brightline will accept a vendor credit + in-kind. If direct donation, procurement will expect an invoice or donation memo.

3) Receipt: Legal prefers we send a draft receipt to the recipient org for signature only if the donation is direct. Otherwise we’ll issue a credit note and a separate statement.

Please confirm which path we take and I’ll route it to finance. Laura — FYI on the EIN and contacts.

Thanks,
Jordan
Customer Advocacy — Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 15:00:00 -0700
Subject: Finalizing DL-78902: credit note, donation draft, and next steps

Hi Sarah / Procurement team —

Thanks for confirming the donation-match. Per our internal approval, Redwood will process a $150 donation to Brightline Health Foundation (we treat this as the equivalent of the swag pack) and issue a $2,000 account credit applied to the Redwood account associated with DL-78902. Below are the deliverables and timeline: 

- Redwood credit: non-expiring credit of $2,000 will be applied to your account within 5 business days. A credit note is attached for your records (redwood_credit_note_78902.pdf).
- Donation: $150 will be donated via ACH to Brightline Health Foundation. Draft donation receipt attached (donation_receipt_brightline_draft.pdf). Please review and confirm the EIN formatting and payee name.
- Swag: since you elected donation, we will not ship the physical pack. I have included a swag_shipping_label_preview.pdf in case you want a commemorative pack later.

Action items for Brightline to close the loop:
1) Please reply with approval of the draft donation receipt and confirm the exact payee name (as it should appear on bank records).
2) Confirm procurements@brightlinehealth.com will accept the attached credit note as part of your PO documentation.
3) If procurement needs an invoice or formal donor letter on Redwood letterhead, let us know and we’ll produce it (we can attach a PDF signed by our Head of Partnerships).

Attachments: redwood_credit_note_78902.pdf, donation_receipt_brightline_draft.pdf, swag_shipping_label_preview.pdf
DocuSign link for the donation memo (if required): https://app.docusign.com/sign/abc123-redwood-donation

If I don’t hear back by EOD Tuesday (3/23), I’ll proceed with the credit application and schedule the $150 ACH donation for Thursday 3/25.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Program Manager, Customer Advocacy
Redwood Inference
